info.title: OpenSplit
info.description: The server stores rows and enforces one invariant. It computes nothing: splitting, folding balances, simplifying debts and analytics all happen on the device.

Retry.description: stale: re-read, re-compose and send again. permanent: this will be refused identically forever; do not retry. transient: back off and try the same request again.

EmailFlow.description: linkPending: verifying keeps the current account id, so every group on this device still belongs to it. signInPending: the address already had an account, so verifying REPLACES the session, and anything recorded as a guest stays with the guest account.

payload.description: The after-image, in whatever shape `kind` calls for: EntrySnapshot, MemberEventPayload, GroupEventPayload or LinkEventPayload.

post.summary: Attach Google to this session, or sign in with it
post.description: Tries to link first, so the account id survives and nothing on the device has to move. Falls back to signing in only when the Google account provably belongs to somebody already, and only when allowSignIn says the cost has already been explained to the person.

409.description: That Google account already has an account of its own, and allowSignIn was not set.

post.summary: Send a sign-in code, and say which flow it started

200.description: A code is on its way

post.summary: Complete the flow that POST /identity/email started

401.description: That code was for a flow this session cannot finish.

get.summary: Who I am, and which groups to ask
Everything that changed in one group since a cursor
get.description: `limit` counts changes, not rows. Every row written by one call shares a sequence number and a page is only ever cut between numbers, so a device sees a whole write or none of it — it can never observe an expense whose shares have not arrived. Send `seq` back as `since` next time.

200.description: The page, and the cursor to send next time

patch.summary: Change a name, a payment handle, or whether somebody is still here
patch.description: Your own row and any placeholder are editable; another account holder's are not — including by whoever made the group. Leaving is always yours to do; removing somebody else requires them to be settled in every currency.

post.summary: Record or edit an expense, whole
post.description: Whole rather than by column: an amount, its payers and its shares are one coherent fact. Send `baseSeq` to be told when somebody else has moved the money since you composed the edit — a stale base is refused only when applying the write would move money, so two people fixing a typo never arbitrate.
